name: Stremio
author: Korie
description: Films, series, channels and live TV from Stremio add-ons. Add each add-on's address (its manifest.json) in the settings: films go under Films, series and channels under Series, TV under Live TV, and Search asks them too. Streams play when an add-on gives a web address for them; add-ons that only give torrents can't be played.

settings.label: Stremio add-ons
settings.help: The address of each add-on's manifest.json (stremio:// addresses work too).
